digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation (S2a)
propositions: A stdlib-only CLI parser factory protocol and immutable route registry must be defined to describe routes without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must hold lazy handler/parser-factory references plus metadata (identity, alias, visibility, help, mount/init, confirmation/output, capability) and support validation of duplicates, alias/retired collisions, contradictions, and malformed references.

The custom ArgumentParser formatter must produce deterministic help output (fixed width, UTF-8 LF, trailing newline, ordered options) and compatibility-shaped parse errors independent of terminal width.

Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, illegal alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capability IDs, and malformed references without resolving handlers or optional packages.
Derived legacy policy-set exports from routes must achieve zero shadow-census delta parity with current command sets and arms.
